topic: This week in AI: agent-powered hacking, Meta's terms U-turn, Anthropic's safety bill, ChatGPT Slides, AI stocks slide
post:
AI agents went on the attack, and the rulebook got rewritten. 📚
Here are this week's 5 AI stories worth your time, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ AI agents hacked 100+ sites
Reuters reports one hacker used AI agents to break into websites of more than 100 companies, with instructions under 100 characters.

2️⃣ Meta backs off "train"
After publisher backlash, Meta removed a sentence about using crawled content to train its products from its new business terms. The crawling permission stays.

3️⃣ Anthropic's draft safety bill
It would let the Commerce Department ask a judge to suspend a model, but only past a high bar: over $1 billion in damage or 50+ people at risk.

4️⃣ ChatGPT now makes slides
Slides is rolling out to Pro, Business and Enterprise users with Space access, with export to PowerPoint, PDF and Google Slides.

5️⃣ AI stocks slide again
AI stocks dragged markets lower as oil climbed and investors worried about the cost of borrowing to build data centers.

Why it matters:
AI is now powerful enough to attack, regulate and reshape office work, all in one week. The fine print matters as much as the features. 🔍

Practical takeaway:
Pick one story and ask: what does this change for my team on Monday? 🧠

Which story surprised you most? 👇

Follow for daily AI news you can actually use.
